Text.name: guidelines
Text.value: Read the question and answer, then determine if it contains the following features, based on the provided definitions below:

Text.name: analogy_guidelines
Text.value: A systematic mapping between two situations: the source (familiar situation) and the target (novel situation).

Text.name: metaphor_guidelines
Text.value: Metaphors structure one concept in terms of another. Unlike analogies, metaphors do not necessarily map directly between source and target; similarities can be associative.

Text.name: connection_guidelines
Text.value: An explicit connection to common knowledge, a previous event, or a news story that was not already embedded in the question.
